food_identity: Quiet Uva hill-country town with strong everyday Sri Lankan rice-and-curry culture, vegetable-forward meals, tea-country identity, family-run eateries, small cafés and a smaller tourism-facing dining scene than Ella.
best_use_cases: authentic local lunch,vegetarian hill-country meals,budget food,tea stops,family dining,slow-travel food experiences
social_insights: Public sources suggest Bandarawela's value is less about a large trendy restaurant scene and more about simple local meals, tea-country context and family-run dining. Recommendation should weight authenticity and value more than review volume.
